description.blurb: Thiazzi (formerly S/2004 S33 and Saturn LXIII) is a natural satellite of Saturn discovered in 2004 and announced in 2019.
description.more: In mythology, Thiazzi is a Norse giant, and a son of Alvaldi who kidnapped Idun, guardian of the apples of the gods. Thiazzi is about 4 kilometres in diameter, and orbits Saturn in 1403.18 days, at an inclination of 160° to the ecliptic.
